title: Degenerate case: currents of degree above the ambient dimension
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with P < n, let S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and let L ⊆ ℝ^P be any linear subspace, d := dim L. Then (a) S is a cone (IsConeCurrent S); (b) currentEval (blowUp S (−v) 1) ω = S ω for every v ∈ L and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P); (c) there is S₀ ∈ 𝒟_{n−d}(ℝ^P) (namely S₀ = 0) which is minimizing in ℝ^P, has ∂S₀ = 0 (BoundaryVanishes), is a cone, has spt S₀ ⊆ L^⊥, and satisfies t + y ∈ spt S ⟺ y ∈ spt S₀ and HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ⟺ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ for all t ∈ L, y ∈ L^⊥, θ ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), P < n → IsConeCurrent S ∧ (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω) ∧ ∃ S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), IsMinimizingIn S₀ univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S₀ ∧ IsConeCurrent S₀ ∧ S₀.support ⊆ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, (t + y ∈ S.support ↔ y ∈ S₀.support)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ θ : ℝ, (HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ↔ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ)
